description: Post a Discussion comment on an initiative, into the same thread the console shows. By default it anchors to the initiative's overview (General discussion); pass `anchor` to comment on a section instead (description, contextNotes = Intake notes, brdContent, or `spec:<section>` for a Spec quote), or `parentId` to reply to an existing comment. The comment is internal unless `clientVisible` is true, which shares it with the client on shared reports. `mentions` notify members (uids from anyforge_list_members). A reply into a resolved thread is refused with `thread_resolved`: reopen it first with anyforge_resolve_initiative_comment. Requires `write` scope and an editor-capable key owner; the comment is posted as the key owner.

anchor.description: Where the comment sits: { anchorKind: "initiative_field", field } with field one of overview (General discussion, the default), description, contextNotes (Intake notes), brdContent, milestone:<id>, spec:<section> (a Spec quote) or doc:<id>. Ignored when replying: a reply joins its parent's thread.

clientVisible.description: true shares the comment with the client on shared reports. Omitted or false keeps it internal (the default).

parentId.description: Reply target — the id of the comment being replied to.

name: anyforge_post_initiative_comment
title: Post initiative comment
